purpose: Teach: 佞/膺/从/レイプ/横田/中原/田口/五郎

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、佞言、つまり佞の政治的虚言の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the history of flattery in political rhetoric, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, steady inquiry. Slight upward lift at the end—not quite a question, more an invitation to confirm. Measured pace. The tone of a teacher who's already read the work and is curious what he'll say about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、膺懲、つまり膺の古い軍事用語の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I actually wrote mine on the history of military commendation as an old Japanese term.
lines.style: Clear and direct, with a small hesitation at the start—collecting his thoughts. Formal register, respectful. Steady delivery, no rush. Slight pride in the specificity without overstatement.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、漢字の从、つまり旧字の「従う」の字形研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined the character forms of an older version of 'follow'—the kanji scholarship there was quite detailed.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective cadence. Gentle confirmation, not correction. Slightly slower pace, as if turning the idea over. Warm recognition of the depth of his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、性犯罪、つまりレイプ事案の刑法的研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Right, but my actual paper was on criminal law scholarship regarding sexual assault cases.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact. No apology in the tone, but grounded—a serious topic handled with professional calm. Steady delivery. Brief, respectful correction without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、横田基地周辺地域の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Mm, and the sociological research around the Yokota military base area—that was your focus.
lines.style: Gently exploratory, as if working through a list in her mind. Unhurried. A small pause before the statement, letting it sit. Curious but not pressing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中原中也、つまり詩人中原の文学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my paper was on the literary criticism of Nakahara Chuya—the poet. That was my focus.
lines.style: Polite but clearer correction this time. A touch of gentle insistence, without frustration. He's clarifying what matters. Steady eye contact in the voice—not uncertain, not rude.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、写真家田口氏のドキュメンタリー研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Right, the documentary research on photographer Taguchi—I had that down for your work.
lines.style: Accepting the correction with grace. Slight acknowledge-and-move-on rhythm. Warm, unbothered. She's checking off a list but not rigidly attached to it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦前の作家五郎氏の文学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, that one was actually my paper on prewar literary criticism—the writer Goro and his work.
lines.style: Final, gentle clarification. A small firmness underneath—he's being patient but also clear that this is what he wrote. Not annoyed, just certain. Closes with quiet conviction.
